full_sentence: Anna has just finished her report.

options.why_wrong: The future 'will' does not fit 'has just', which describes an action completed a very short time before now.
The present continuous does not follow 'has just'. The present perfect needs a past participle such as 'finished'.
'Yesterday' is a finished time and cannot be used with the present perfect 'has just'.

explanation: 'Just' shows that an action was completed a very short time before the present moment. After 'has just', we need the past participle to show a completed action linked to now. Ukrainian speakers may use a simple past form here, because the Ukrainian past tense does not link the action to the present in the same way.
